g1.flow: Al-Māʿūn says wa-lā yaḥuḍḍu, like Al-Ḥāqqah, because it describes one person: 'the one who drives away the orphan'. Al-Ḥāqqah's 'he' is the one who did not believe in Allāh. Al-Fajr is the odd one out: wa-lā taḥāḍḍūna, since the ayat around it speak to 'you' (you do not honor the orphan). Hook: 'the one' gives yaḥuḍḍu; 'you' gives taḥāḍḍūna.

cues.69:34: Wa-lā yaḥuḍḍu: after 'he did not believe in Allāh, the Most Great'.
cues.89:18: Wa-lā taḥāḍḍūna: 'you' do not honor the orphan, then 'you' do not urge one another.
cues.107:3: Wa-lā yaḥuḍḍu: after 'the one who drives away the orphan'; then woe to those who pray.
